name: Kinou Yumeto
source:
The protagonist. Around 30 years old, he is taking notice of his slightly developing belly.
With the power of a magic book he obtained by chance, he returned to the world 13 years in the past. Yet there, he encountered an "senior" he has no memory of.

[Translated from [url=https://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/nh/#character]official website[/url]]
